title: Private Train Kiln Firing Service
bring: bisque fired work (up to 6 participants with 2-2.5 cubic feet each)
how_to_join: Call 845-332-6585 or email absartorius@gmail.com to book; may take up to a year to plan into schedule
source_quote: Private Train Kiln Firing: Would you, and up to 5 other artists, like to book a private wood firing workshop with one of our instructors? This firing allows up to 5 participants 2-2.5 cubic feet each of bisque fired work to be glazed and fired during the 4 day workshop.
summary: A private wood firing service for 1-6 participants in the train kiln, a smaller wood kiln than the anagama. The 4-day workshop may require up to a year of advance planning.
evidence_sentence: The private firing page describes a private train kiln workshop where participants get wood firing experience with less time commitment than the anagama.
evidence_quote: Would you, and up to 5 other artists, like to book a private wood firing workshop with one of our instructors? This firing allows up to 5 participants 2-2.5 cubic feet each of bisque fired work to be glazed and fired during the 4 day workshop.
